summary: Valion Bio filed an 8-K reporting a tranche closing under an existing Securities Purchase Agreement with investor 3i, LP. The company issued 250 Series B Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Shares at $1,000 per share and a warrant to purchase 156,026 common shares at $0.616280 per share, for aggregate proceeds of $250,000. This is a routine registered direct or PIPE-style issuance, not a special situation. The securities were sold under Rule 506(b)/Section 4(a)(2) exemption. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural shift is noted. The filing is a standard unregistered equity sale, not an acquisition, restructuring, or other special-situation event.
